v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Tota pulchra * es, María, et mácula originális non est in te.
text.en: Thou art all fair, O Mary, * there is no spot of original sin in thee.

text.la: Vestiméntum tuum * cándidum quasi nix, et fácies tua sicut sol.
text.en: Thy raiment * is white as snow, and thy countenance as the sun.

text.la: Tu glória Ierúsalem, * tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri.
text.en: Thou art the exaltation of Jerusalem, * thou art the great glory of Israel, thou art the great rejoicing of our nation.

text.la: Benedícta es tu, * Virgo María, a Dómino Deo excélso præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
text.en: Virgin Mary, * blessed art thou of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth.

text.la: Trahe nos, * Virgo immaculáta, post te currémus in odórem unguentórum tuórum.
text.en: Draw us, * Maiden undefiled, we will run after thee in the odour of thy perfumes.

text.la: Dóminus possédit me in inítio viárum suárum, ántequam quidquam fáceret a princípio. Ab ætérno ordináta sum, et ex antíquis ántequam terra fíeret. Nondum erant abýssi, et ego iam concépta eram.
text.en: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his ways, before he made any thing from the beginning. I was set up from eternity, and of old before the earth was made. The depths were not as yet, and I was already conceived.

v.la: Immaculáta Concéptio est hódie sanctæ Maríæ Vírginis.
v.en: This day is the Holy Virgin Mary conceived without sin.

r.la: Quæ serpéntis caput virgíneo pede contrívit.
r.en: The Virgin's foot hath bruised the serpent's head.

text.la: Ait Dóminus Deus * ad serpéntem: Inimicítias ponam inter te et mulíerem, et semen tuum et semen illíus: ipsa cónteret caput tuum, allelúia.
text.en: The Lord God said * to the serpent: I will put enmities between thee and the woman, and thy seed and her seed: she shall crush thy head, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui per immaculátam Vírginis Conceptiónem dignum Fílio tuo habitáculum præparásti: quǽsumus; ut qui ex morte eiúsdem Fílii tui prævísa, eam ab omni labe præservásti, nos quoque mundos eius intercessióne ad te perveníre concédas.
text.en: O God, by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin, thou prepared a worthy habitation for thy Son; we beseech thee, that, as by the foreseen death of thy same Son thou preserved her from all stain of sin, so thou would grant us also, through her intercession, to come to thee with pure hearts.

title.la: Feria VI infra Hebdomadam I Adventus
title.en: Feria VI infra Hebdomadam I Adventus

text.la: Ecce véniet Deus et homo de domo David sedére in throno, allelúia.
text.en: He that is both God and man shall come of the house of David and sit in David's seat. Alleluia.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;

office.title: In Conceptione Immaculata Beatæ Mariæ Virginis
